يرتعفون (form VIII)
# يَرْتَعِفُونَ (yartaʕifūna) /jar.ta.ʕi.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# يُرْتَعَفُونَ (yurtaʕafūna) /jur.ta.ʕa.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
